product_type: Dairy milk and dairy drinks, including sweetened and flavoured UHT milk
example_brands: Vinamilk, TH true MILK, Dutch Lady
excluded_by_tcvn_12828: yes: "Sữa và sản phẩm từ sữa"
basis: TCVN 12828:2019 scope excludes milk and milk products; Decree 360/2025 adopts TCVN 12828:2019 as the definition
notes: Exempt however much sugar it contains.

product_type: Soy milk (sữa đậu nành) above 5 g total sugar per 100 ml
example_brands: Fami and Fami Canxi (Vinasoy), Vinamilk, Nutifood, Homesoy
national_standard: TCVN 12443:2018 Sữa đậu nành (own standard, protein at least 2.0 g per 100 ml; committee TCVN/TC/F6 nutrition)
food_safety_regulation_declared: QCVN 6-2:2010/BYT, the regulation for non-alcoholic beverages (Vinasoy declarations 2025 and 2026)
excluded_by_tcvn_12828: not on the face of it: soy milk is not "sữa" under TCVN 11216:2015 (milk is a mammary secretion); a fortified variant might argue "liquid food for nutritional purposes"
likely_excise_status_2027: unclear; likely taxable on a plain reading
basis: Fits the TCVN 12828 definition (ready to drink, made from water, may contain sugar and ingredients of natural origin); classed as a non-alcoholic beverage in customs (heading 2202) and in food-safety declarations; no official ruling found
source_ids: FTR-02; FTR-05; FTR-06; FTR-07; FTR-08; FTR-17; FTR-20; FTR-32; APR-22
notes: Our legal reading, not a ruling. Counter-argument: soy milk has its own national standard, drafted by the nutrition committee.

product_type: Nut and seed milks above 5 g total sugar per 100 ml

food_safety_regulation_declared: QCVN 6-2:2010/BYT, declared as "thực phẩm bổ sung" (supplemented food) (Veyo declarations)
excluded_by_tcvn_12828: no explicit exclusion; same argument as FTR-EX-02 on "sữa"
likely_excise_status_2027: unclear; likely taxable on a plain reading
basis: No product standard of their own; declared under the non-alcoholic beverage regulation
source_ids: FTR-05; FTR-07; FTR-08; FTR-26; FTR-27; FTR-28
notes: Our legal reading, not a ruling.

product_type: Oat, rice and corn milks above 5 g total sugar per 100 ml
example_brands: Veyo oat, Vinamilk oat, Nutifood brown-rice and corn milk, imported oat drinks
national_standard: None found (cereal drinks sit inside TCVN 12828:2019)
named_in_tcvn_12828_scope: yes: "các loại đồ uống từ ngũ cốc" (cereal drinks)
basis: TCVN 12828:2019 names cereal drinks in its scope; intrinsic sugars from enzymatic hydrolysis count, because the test is total sugar on the label
notes: Unsweetened oat drinks can approach 5 g from hydrolysis sugars alone (Oatly Barista 3.4 g; Veyo oat 4.4 or 6.4 g, label illegible).

product_type: Any plant milk at or below 5 g total sugar per 100 ml
example_brands: Fami Green Soy rất ít đường (3.9 g), Fami Green Soy không bổ sung đường, Vinamilk Cao Đạm Không Đường, TH true NUT walnut (carbohydrate 4.3 g), Oatly Barista (3.4 g)
basis: Below the 5 g per 100 ml threshold on the label
source_ids: FTR-01; FTR-02; FTR-23; FTR-24; FTR-30; FORM-01
notes: Sweeteners do not count as sugar under the label test (our reading of Decree 360/2025 Art 3(4)(b)).
